correctness.rationale: For connected simple G and one negative edge uv under the exact self-inclusive strict synchronous Kann–Feng rule, all-edge-receptive orientations give x_next=(I-D^-1 L)x ± c D^-1(e_v-e_u). The D-mean is invariant and the Laplacian Poisson solution has endpoint voltage R_G(u,v). The electrical maximum principle places all node voltages between endpoints; R<1 exactly for nonbridges (parallel alternate path), R=1 for bridges. Thus two interior fixed states per fixed D-mean iff nonbridge, with exact margin c(1-R); at a bridge the hostile edge hits excluded strict threshold. P is reversible, irreducible, lazy and aperiodic, proving local exponential attraction on the D-mean-zero hyperplane. The tie orientation has no extra stationary solution. Independent enumerated 4294 connected graph/edge cases through n=5, and checked potentials and affine fixed points; the all-graph proof is analytic, not enumeration.
